- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.7.0"
    node_exporter_port: 9100
    node_exporter_user: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_install_dir: "/usr/local/bin"
    node_exporter_temp_dir: "/tmp"
    node_exporter_os: "linux"
    node_exporter_arch_map:
      x86_64: "amd64"
      aarch64: "arm64"
      armv7l: "armv7"
      armv6l: "armv6"
      ppc64le: "ppc64le"
      s390x: "s390x"
    node_exporter_arch: "{{ node_exporter_arch_map[ansible_architecture] | default(ansible_architecture) }}"
    node_exporter_dist_name: "node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.{{ node_exporter_os }}-{{ node_exporter_arch }}"
    node_exporter_tarball: "{{ node_exporter_dist_name }}.tar.gz"
    node_exporter_download_base: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}"
    node_exporter_url: "{{ node_exporter_download_base }}/{{ node_exporter_tarball }}"
    node_exporter_checksum_url: "{{ node_exporter_download_base }}/sha256sums.txt"
    node_exporter_env_file: "{{ '/etc/default/node_exporter' if ansible_os_family in ['Debian', 'Suse'] else '/etc/sysconfig/node_exporter' }}"
    node_exporter_extra_opts: ""
    node_exporter_nologin_shell: "{{ '/sbin/nologin' if ansible_os_family == 'RedHat' else '/usr/sbin/nologin' }}"

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure node_exporter group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        system: true

    - name: Ensure node_exporter user exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        system: true
        shell: "{{ node_exporter_nologin_shell }}"
        create_home: false

    - name: Create install directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Fetch node_exporter checksums
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_checksum_url }}"
        return_content: true
        status_code: 200
      register: node_exporter_checksums

    - name: Set node_exporter checksum fact
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_checksum: "{{ (node_exporter_checksums.content).splitlines() | select('search', node_exporter_tarball ~ '$') | list | first | regex_search('^([a-fA-F0-9]{64})') }}"

    - name: Download node_exporter tarball (verified)
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_url }}"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_temp_dir }}/{{ node_exporter_tarball }}"
        mode: "0644"
        checksum: "sha256:{{ node_exporter_checksum }}"

    - name: Unarchive node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "{{ node_exporter_temp_dir }}/{{ node_exporter_tarball }}"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_temp_dir }}"
        remote_src: true
        creates: "{{ node_exporter_temp_dir }}/{{ node_exporter_dist_name }}/node_exporter"

    - name: Install node_exporter binary
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ node_exporter_temp_dir }}/{{ node_exporter_dist_name }}/node_exporter"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}/node_exporter"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true
      notify: Restart node_exporter

    - name: Create environment file for node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_env_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          NODE_EXPORTER_OPTS="--web.listen-address=:{{ node_exporter_port }} {{ node_exporter_extra_opts | default('') | trim }}"
      notify: Restart node_exporter

    - name: Install systemd unit for node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Prometheus Node Exporter
          Documentation=https://prometheus.io/docs/guides/node-exporter/
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          User={{ node_exporter_user }}
          Group={{ node_exporter_user }}
          Type=simple
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ node_exporter_env_file }}
          ExecStart={{ node_exporter_install_dir }}/node_exporter $NODE_EXPORTER_OPTS
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s
          NoNewPrivileges=yes
          ProtectSystem=full
          ProtectHome=yes
          PrivateTmp=yes
          PrivateDevices=yes
          ProtectControlGroups=yes
          ProtectKernelModules=yes
          ProtectKernelTunables=yes
          ProtectClock=yes
          LockPersonality=yes
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
          RestrictNamespaces=yes
          RestrictRealtime=yes
          RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
          RemoveIPC=yes
          AmbientCapabilities=
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          LimitNOFILE=8192

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      register: node_exporter_unit

    - name: Reload systemd if unit changed
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: node_exporter_unit.changed

    - name: Enable and start node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: node_exporter
        enabled: true
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: Restart node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: node_exporter
        state: restarted
